title: KKT segmentation validity: automatic verb-bounded units vs. UD gold clauses (Uzbek)
description: Data and scripts comparing the automatic verb-bounded units of the KKT analysis pipeline (rule V0) with the gold clauses of the Uzbek Universal Dependencies treebanks UD_Uzbek-UT and UD_Uzbek-UzUDT (1 182 sentences): boundary precision and recall for a broad and a narrow gold definition, and the Heaps-type exponent of the clause-pattern inventory for V0 units, gold clauses on system tags and gold clauses on gold tags.
